title: Direct debit
intro: With the mandate you allow your provider to collect the fees from your account.
savedButStale: Your change is saved. Only the display is not up to date yet.
off: Your provider does not accept the mandate in the app. Ask your provider for a paper form.
creditorMissing: Your provider cannot accept direct debits yet. Please try again later.
noRight: The mandate is given by parents who may send registrations for this child.
replacementDescription: No further collection is possible with this mandate. Revoke it and grant a new one.
activeDescription: You allow your provider to collect fees from this account. Your invoice tells you how to pay.
ibanHint: For your safety we only show the last four digits.
textDescription: You confirmed this text. Save it for your records.
revokeBody: From the next invoice on, your provider no longer collects from this account.
revokeRunning: A collection that is already with the bank still goes through.
revokePay: Your provider tells you how to pay instead.
replaceHint: Want to use another account? First revoke this mandate. Then give a new one.
stepAccountDescription: Enter the account your provider may collect from.
stepConfirmDescription: Please read the text. It applies once you confirm below.
holderHint: As the name appears at your bank.
bicHint: Only needed if your bank is outside the EU.
holderConfirm: I am the holder of this account.
holderConfirmError: Please confirm that the account is yours.
onlyOwnAccount: The mandate is only for your own account.
textChanged: The text has changed. Please read and confirm it again.
ibanInvalid: This IBAN is not correct. Please check every digit.
privacy: We store your account details encrypted. Your provider uses the full IBAN only for the collection.
inboxButtonTooltip: Opens the direct debit mandate for this contract.
revokeTooltip: Revokes the mandate for this account. moto asks you first.
revokeConfirmTooltip: Revokes the mandate right away for all further invoices.
revokeCloseTooltip: Closes the window; the mandate stays valid.
downloadTooltip: Saves the text of the mandate as a file on your device.
nextTooltip: Checks your details and shows the text of the mandate.
backTooltip: Shows your account details again; the mandate is not given yet.
grantTooltip: Gives the mandate right away; your provider may then debit.
